source_identity_verification.connected_commit: Exact SHA returned by GitHub.fetch_commit; canonical repository URL matched.
source_identity_verification.connected_registry: Exact-baseline registerAllCharts matched the authorized packet.

method.external: Read-only current first-party documentation and standards research; no product hands-on tests.
method.repository: All133 packet section hashes verified; source-reading route and targeted supplemental exact-baseline reads.
method.frequency: Original H/M/L scenario hypotheses; no telemetry, no observed usage frequencies.
method.dates: Access date follows the requested research date2026-10-12. Source publication/update dates included only where available; null means not established.
method.link_policy: Ordinary primary URLs and immutable repository anchors; no chat-only citation tokens.

product_mechanics.object_hit: Marks Color control or color legend
product_mechanics.gesture: Assign a field to Color; legend menu → Edit Colors
product_mechanics.result: Categorical assignments or continuous scale editor
product_mechanics.persistence: Desktop confirms with OK; web closing applies documented color changes. Workbook save lifecycle not examined.
product_mechanics.undo: Reset is documented; web Undo can restore color changes. Granularity not established.
product_mechanics.transfer: Let the legend identify the encoding; label shared explorEDA ownership explicitly.

product_mechanics.gesture: Double-click or right-click Format; then select object and right-click
product_mechanics.result: Format mode, mini-toolbar and overlapping-target correction
product_mechanics.persistence: Report edit; per-action save lifecycle not established by inspected page
product_mechanics.undo: Not established; source warns some Reset cases are incomplete
product_mechanics.mode: Explicit authoring format mode replaces click semantics
product_mechanics.transfer: Borrow target correction, not a default edit mode; small-multiple and accessibility limitations oppose uncritical transfer.

product_mechanics.object_hit: Visualization top-right control or context menu
product_mechanics.gesture: Hover then menu; or right-click → Exploration menu
product_mechanics.result: Data, sort, color and label properties without data selection
product_mechanics.scope: Visualization; alternative fields must already be supplied
product_mechanics.persistence: Session changes; eligible editable unpublished sheets can Apply or Discard
product_mechanics.undo: Discard documented; fine-grained undo not established
product_mechanics.transfer: Separate configuration from selection; do not import a second temporary saved-state model.

product_mechanics.gesture: Select variable then click zone, or drag; zone menu swaps/removes; context menus vary by hit
product_mechanics.scope: Graph/element or all graphs depending documented menu route
product_mechanics.persistence: Graph Builder state changes; durable save lifecycle not examined
product_mechanics.transfer: Visible bindings and non-drag alternative transfer; modifier-only group scope does not.

product_mechanics.object_hit: Graph object or Object Manager selection
product_mechanics.gesture: Select object; click a mini-toolbar command; Shift can re-show faded toolbar
product_mechanics.result: Object-specific compact tools, including Group/Single choices
product_mechanics.persistence: Object formatting changes; save lifecycle not examined
product_mechanics.transfer: A short object toolbar can be useful, but requires an explicit non-filtering entry in explorEDA.

product_mechanics.gesture: Right-click element → Format; selecting another element retargets pane
product_mechanics.persistence: Workbook-edit context; save behavior not separately researched
product_mechanics.transfer: A correctly focused full editor is a strong minimal alternative to inventing many tiny editors.

product_mechanics.object_hit: Legend color bar or series label
product_mechanics.gesture: Color bar click opens picker; label click isolates series
product_mechanics.result: Color choice or automatically created series override
product_mechanics.scope: Series visual appearance, not linked row selection
product_mechanics.persistence: Save dashboard preserves override for viewers
product_mechanics.undo: No grouped undo claim; reselecting can restore series display
product_mechanics.transfer: The legend is useful real estate, but its click convention conflicts with explorEDA category filtering.

product_mechanics.object_hit: Point/label within Annotate, or chart after Add range highlight
product_mechanics.gesture: Pick label directly or from dropdown; explicit range action then drag
product_mechanics.persistence: Authoring before a separate Publish step
product_mechanics.undo: Specific label removal documented; general undo grouping unknown
product_mechanics.transfer: Explicit one-shot annotation intent transfers; plain point-click editing does not.
